## Towing Muscle






A Heavyweight of Heavy Weights








The dynamic 3.5L EcoBoost® engine cranks out an available commanding 13,500 lbs\* of astounding pulling strength — setting F-150® trucks apart from the rest.















[Go to Towing](https://www.ford.com/trucks/f150/specs/360viewer/#towing)

- ![Close-up of the seat on a 2027 Ford F-150® XLT pickup with the Carhartt® Package](https://www.assets.ford.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:36aa8e2f-2666-4316-b60b-1847b2bb96a7/as/_L8A0313_1d_V2a_V1.webp?max-quality=75&crop-names=1_3x4&width=1920)



























## F-150® Carhartt® Package






Two Icons. One Seriously Rugged Truck.








Durability and longevity go hand-in-hand. The available new F-150 Carhartt Package combines outstanding performance, rugged design, and proven engineering to take on the hardest and dirtiest jobs.















[Go to Carhartt](https://www.ford.com/trucks/f150/specs/360viewer/#packages)

- ![2027 Ford F-150® Lariat® pickup pulling a boat on a highway](https://www.assets.ford.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:2472f37f-638b-48bf-91b3-4801070e0eec/as/_90A3079_V1.webp?max-quality=75&crop-names=1_3x4&width=1920)







































































































## Available BlueCruise with Towing






Hook Up, Tow Hands-Free, With Eyes on the Road








Just when you thought the convenience of hands-free highway driving couldn’t get any better, we’ve added available hands-free towing to the mix.\*















[Go to BlueCruise](https://www.ford.com/trucks/f150/specs/360viewer/#technology)

- ![2027 Ford F-150® Raptor R™ truck being driven in the desert kicking up a cloud of sand](https://www.assets.ford.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:9350cbb7-a471-4017-9eac-bd9daebbfd82/as/27_FRD_F15_rptr_Chase_March_5_v2.webp?max-quality=75&crop-names=1_3x4&width=1920)







































































































## Off-Roading






Conquers Most Anything Under Their Wheels








Overcome. Don't surrender. Thick woods or desert dunes, F-150® off-road trucks are packed with power, a stout suspension, armored skid plates, and earth-devouring all-terrain tires.\*















[Go to Off-Road](https://www.ford.com/trucks/f150/specs/360viewer/#towing)

- ![2027 Ford F-150® Platinum® model towing a camper](https://www.assets.ford.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:5c1d8a34-c3e1-4bac-b258-cbaa9baf2efd/as/27_FRD_F15_64541_plt_mrgr.webp?max-quality=75&crop-names=1_3x4&width=1920)



























## 3.5L PowerBoost® Full Hybrid Engine






Double the Input. Maximum Output.








The mighty full hybrid V6 engine incorporates both gas and electric performance while easily towing up to 12,100 lbs.\* And with the standard Pro Power Onboard™,76 electricity is on hand when needed.















[Go to Performance](https://www.ford.com/trucks/f150/specs/360viewer/#performance)
